data.name: Tactician
data.description: At 3rd level, 9th level, and 18th level, a tactical leader gains a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat.

raw_tokens.value: At 3rd level, 9th level, and 18th level, a tactical leader gains a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat.
As a standard action, the tactical leader can grant|!PRECLASS:1,Inquisitor=12
As a swift action, the tactical leader can grant|PRECLASS:1,Inquisitor=12
any two teamwork feats that he knows, not just his bonus feats,|PRECLASS:1,Inquisitor=18

to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear him. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for %1 rounds. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. The tactical leader can use this ability %2/day.
